scientific_role: prospective same-geography different-taxon test of sparse-source configuration sensitivity; not a temporal conservation validation and not a rescue of the completed beetle primary

topology_null.actual_graph: minimal connected symmetrized kNN graph frozen by v1.01; selected k=3; 35 edges
topology_null.null_rule: degree-preserving double-edge swaps; replacement edges must remain in the same actual-edge geographic-length quintile as the removed edges; graph must remain connected
topology_null.edge_length_quintiles: Hyndman-Fan type 7 q20/q40/q60/q80 of the 35 actual edge lengths; actual graph has exactly 7 edges per bin
topology_null.uniqueness: all 20 final edge sets must be distinct and distinct from the actual graph; increment nonce deterministically on collision
topology_null.changed_features: candidate C graph-path occupied-source distance/pressure only
topology_null.fixed_across_nulls: R0-R3, state reference, Euclidean source features, generic actual-graph R2 context, island split, pilot response and fitting rules

configuration_sensitivity.target_heterogeneity_H_i: population variance of the six candidate-source weights divided by squared mean weight
configuration_sensitivity.species_source_count_n: number of occupied pilot islands for that bird species after one burned-pilot opening
configuration_sensitivity.eligible_species: 2 <= n <= 6; n=1 is excluded prospectively because focal-exclusion leaves zero sources on its sole occupied training row; n=0 is source-inestimable
configuration_sensitivity.response_independence: H_i and the complete null ensemble are frozen before any bird response access; n is learned from pilot only before any confirmatory response access

pilot_gate.purpose: estimability only; no ecological effect score
pilot_gate.if_fail: STOP bird route before confirmatory response; do not relax thresholds

model_family.reference: reuse the frozen 19-island state/reference ladder without retuning: R0 habitat PCs+TSF; R1 area+mainland distance; R2 actual generic graph context; R3 pilot-only prevalence+Euclidean occupied-source distance/pressure
model_family.candidate_actual: R3 plus actual-graph path occupied-source distance/pressure
model_family.candidate_nulls: 20 models identical to candidate_actual except graph-path source features are computed on each frozen rewired graph
model_family.fitting: deterministic pooled ridge logistic regression, lambda=1, same numerical rules as boreal beetle v1.09
model_family.training: pilot bird rows only; focal pilot island excluded from its own occupied-source set
model_family.predictions: freeze R3, actual C and 20 null-C probabilities for every eligible species x 13 confirmatory islands before confirmatory response

primary.endpoint: realized-presence cells only after one confirmatory bird-response opening
primary.delta: binary_logloss(actual_C) minus mean binary_logloss(null_C_1..20); negative favours actual topology
primary.predictor: pre-response standardized S_i(n) over the complete frozen confirmatory prediction surface
primary.estimand: coefficient of standardized S in OLS delta ~ confirmatory_block_fixed_effects + standardized_S among positive heldout cells
primary.uncertainty: 10,000 deterministic spatial-block bootstrap replicates over the seven frozen confirmatory blocks; refit the block-fixed-effect slope in each replicate
primary.support_rule: point estimate < 0 and 95% bootstrap upper bound < 0
primary.non_estimable_rule: if fewer than 3 confirmatory blocks contain positive eligible cells or the positive-cell standardized-S variance is zero, primary is NON_ESTIMABLE and route ends

secondary_nonrescuing: actual C better than each individual rewired C on positive cells
actual C minus R3 on positive cells
source-count-stratified summaries using the predeclared n values
claim_boundary: same geography means this is taxonomic/mechanistic replication, not geographically independent replication
cross-sectional bird occurrence does not demonstrate colonization, rescue or demographic persistence
a positive bird result cannot reverse the completed beetle primary
a positive bird result cannot validate static source leverage as a management ranking metric
BALA remains the independent temporal consequence boundary
next_action: freeze the response-independent topology-null ensemble and H_i surface; only after those exact objects are committed may a separate bird pilot-response authorization be constructed
